purpose: Audit clean-only multimodal appearance priors after local conditional prediction and unimodal clean statistics failed on persistent Epic fog.

reference.scope: same camera view and exact 40x40 feature-grid position
reference.route_balancing: minimum distance within each clean route, followed by the mean of the five nearest distinct clean routes
reference.clean_calibration: leave-one-route-out raw score for every one of the 560 clean frames, then per-view-position median/MAD positive-tail calibration
reference.l2_feature_standardization: clean-only per-view-position-channel mean/std with a per-position 10th-percentile scale floor

candidates.appearance_route_knn_cosine_z: Route-balanced five-nearest-clean-route cosine distance on the full 1024-D patch direction.
candidates.appearance_route_knn_standardized_l2_z: Route-balanced five-nearest-clean-route Euclidean distance after clean-only per-view-position-channel standardization; unlike the failed diagonal distance, this retains a multimodal nearest-clean-manifold reference.

checks: fog_heavy score mean > fog_light score mean
score versus paired-clean patch-delta Spearman >= 0.10 at both fog levels
score AUROC for the top 20 percent paired-delta patches >= 0.60 at both fog levels
paired-clean delta mean is positive and fog_heavy > fog_light
fog_heavy > fog_light > clear score mean independently on both routes

decision.no_candidate_passes: Stop clean-feature manifold engineering on this development family and design a learned clean density/evidence model before any adapter training.
decision.candidate_passes: Freeze the passing appearance definition and test it on a new native sensor or weather family that was not used to design it; adapter training remains unauthorized.

claim_boundary: Epic fog is now architecture-development evidence, not an untouched confirmation set. A pass cannot support external generalization by itself.
